title: Hazel decision record
description: A confirmed decision. Written only after librarian approval. Items awaiting approval are candidates and live in the meeting delta, not here.

id.description: Identifier only. Never sort or infer chronology from this; order by decided_on.

title.description: Short human-readable label for indexes and ticket subjects.

statement.description: The exact approved statement. Immutable once written; supersede rather than edit.

decided_on.description: When the decision was made. Orders supersession chains.

recorded_on.description: When it entered the ledger. Differs from decided_on for backfilled records.

owner.description: Named authority who made or holds the decision, or the literal string unknown.

origin.description: Where this decision came from. A discriminated union so decisions with no originating meeting are first-class.

rationale.description: Why this was decided outside any meeting. Tooling, schema and naming decisions land here.

evidence.description: At least one anchored citation. Retained unchanged from the original contract; this is the strongest guarantee in the layer.

location.description: Anchor. t:MM:SS or t:HH:MM:SS for a transcript timestamp, s:<heading> for a section, l:<n> or l:<n>-<m> for a line range. Copy the timestamp verbatim from the source; validation resolves the excerpt against it.

routing.description: Which repositories and areas this decision affects. An array so a decision touching several layers is one record with several targets.

repo.description: Target repository. hazel-kb covers living-document updates. none means the decision requires no repository change.

area.description: Area within the repo. Convention: onboarding step slug (step-03-documents), module name, or living document name.

spec_impact.description: Whether a spec change is outstanding for this decision.

implemented_by.description: Pull requests implementing this decision. Empty until implementation lands.

approval.description: The librarian gate. A decision record cannot exist without it.
